outcome: Median number of antenatal care visits
Prevalence of mothers attending at least six antenatal care visits
Proportion of mothers starting antenatal care in the first trimester and attending at least six visits
cohort: Four Pelotas birth cohorts (1982, 1993, 2004, 2015) in Brazil
finding: While antenatal care coverage increased and inequalities decreased over time, caesarean section rates increased dramatically, especially in the private sector, with widening income-related inequalities.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates increased dramatically from 1982 to 2015, reaching 93.9% in the private sector.
